newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bond exchange auction totals 11.13 bln Bfr.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bond exchange auction totals 11.13 bln Bfr.

text.p: An exchange auction of Belgian linear bonds (OLOs) totalled 11.13 billion Belgian francs, the Treasury said in a statement.

The Treasury said it exchanged 0.9 billion francs of OLO line 15 (6.75 pct May 1997) for OLO 21 (7.75 pct, December 2000) and 10.23 billion francs of OLO 15 for OLO 7 (9.00 pct June 2001). No other offers were received.
The Treasury had offered to exchange OLO 15 and OLO 22 (9.25 pct August 1997) against OLO 21, OLO 7, OLO 20 (7.75 pct October 2004) and OLO 16 (7.50 pct July 2008).
